record.one_liner: Document parsing, extraction, splitting, classification and form-filling API for PDFs and office files, with an MCP server.
record.auth_notes: Static API key created in Studio (studio.reducto.ai/api-keys), sent as a bearer token and read from REDUCTO_API_KEY. The MCP server's --login flow opens a browser and saves the key to a local config file; it is not a third-party OAuth grant.
record.access_notes: Free account sign-up from the docs, then a key is created in the Studio. Standard pay-as-you-go tier includes $150 of free usage (no stated expiry), so working credentials are issued without payment. critic: access kept self_serve_free; pricing page confirms free credits, Growth/Enterprise are optional.
record.api_notes: Document-focused endpoints: /parse, /extract, /split, /classify, /edit, /upload, plus async variants and GET /job/{job_id}. Not a general-purpose SaaS API.
record.blocker_notes: critic: verdict ready confirmed; mcp official confirmed (hosted at mcp.reducto.ai/mcp, documented on vendor docs).
